candidates.title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
candidates.summary: Learn how to configure Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for an on-behalf-of (OBO) token exchange with Microsoft Entra ID, so an AI agent can call the ServiceNow REST API while preserving the calling user's identity. AgentCore Gateway performs the exchange natively, with no interceptor Lambda or custom code.

candidates.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
candidates.summary: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

candidates.title: Bring structured and unstructured data together with Amazon Quick
candidates.summary: Amazon Quick brings structured and unstructured data together in one experience. In this post, you connect Amazon S3 as a knowledge base, enrich a dataset, build a Space, and create a custom chat agent that answers business questions across both data types through a single conversational interface.

candidates.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
candidates.summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.
